Apply the processor's decisions on quadrat mismatches

dot-apply_small_tree_quadrat_decisions.Rd

Moves the stems marked keep = "name" to the quadrat given by quadrat_by_name, the one taken from the mismatch table unless the decision row names another. A decision is matched to a stem on parent plot and tag, so it survives a re-export as long as those do.

Usage

.apply_small_tree_quadrat_decisions(
  trees,
  mismatches,
  decisions,
  quadrats,
  data_dir = NULL
)

Arguments

trees

Assigned tree data frame (parent_plot_name, tag, quadrat_unit, quadrat_label).

mismatches

Output of .flag_small_tree_name_mismatches(), or NULL.

decisions

Data frame, or path of an xlsx, with parent_plot_name, tag, keep and optionally quadrat_by_name.

quadrats

Quadrat units from .prepare_openforis_small_tree_quadrats().

data_dir

Directory a bare filename in decisions is looked up in, or NULL.

Value

List with trees (stems moved) and mismatches (keep and quadrat_by_name set to what was applied; stems moved by a decision but not flagged are appended).

Details

Anything that cannot be applied as written is an error, not a skip: a decision for a stem that is not there, a quadrat that was not sampled in that parent plot, a "name" without a quadrat, or two decisions for one stem. A silently dropped decision would put a stem back in the quadrat someone had taken it out of.
